name: IFBench
intro: IFBench评估语言模型遵循精确指令的泛化能力，特别是面对陌生输出约束。包含58个新颖且难度较高的可验证域外约束，并提出基于可验证奖励的强化学习方法提升指令执行。
org: Allen Institute for AI, University of Washington
scale: 58个约束，约300个单轮提示，约1300个多轮样本
intro_en: IFBench evaluates language models' ability to generalize in following precise instructions, especially when facing unfamiliar output constraints. It includes 58 novel and challenging verifiable out-of-domain constraints and proposes a reinforcement learning method based on verifiable rewards to improve instruction execution.
scale_en: 58 items constraints, about 300 items single-turn prompts, about 1300 items multi-turn samples

drawio_review_note:
Aligned with arXiv:2507.02833. IFBench defines a taxonomy of precise instruction-following constraints and splits train/test constraints to avoid contamination. The 58 benchmark constraints are manually created from user feedback and manual writing, then filtered to those that can be paired with Python verification functions. Final test prompts instantiate those constraints on held-out WildChat prompts, and each instance is human checked for prompt-constraint compatibility. The benchmark covers seven constraint categories and 300 prompts in single-turn and multi-turn formats, scored with strict and loose accuracy. The paper also releases IFTrain with 29 unseen training constraints and uses IF-RLVR data built from Tulu-3-SFT instructions plus IFEval/IFTrain constraints, avoiding contradictory combinations and training with verifier rewards.

Bilingual Draw.io bundle synchronized from benchmark_importer after paper and official-source review. The Chinese and English specs use identical node IDs, semantic types, coordinates, edges, and waypoints; strict Draw.io validation, XML and link checks, and rendered-image visual review passed before publication.
